article.title: The Role of BRCA1 in DNA Repair

abstract.p: The BRCA1 gene is a tumor suppressor gene whose mutations are linked to an increased risk of breast and ovarian cancer. BRCA1 plays a crucial role in DNA damage repair pathways, particularly homologous recombination. Understanding its function is vital for developing targeted therapies. This article reviews the current knowledge on BRCA1's involvement in maintaining genomic stability. © 2023 Author et al.
